description: Use this when the user wants to see a saved chart's earlier publications, find one to read with get_chart_document, or pick one to restore with restore_chart_version. Returns versions newest first with who published each, from where and what changed; requires authentication.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page

limit.description: Page size; defaults to 100 and has a maximum of 1000

named.description: List only versions that were given a name

name: list_chart_versions

currentVersionNumber.description: Number of the version the chart publishes now, or null for a chart that was never published

apiKeyName.description: Name of the API key that published it

changedSections.description: What changed from the version before it; null when it can't be compared

client.description: Where it was published from, when known

kind.description: How the version was made: create, publish, restore, move between workspaces, or imported from before version history

mcpClientName.description: Name of the MCP client that published it

publishedAt.description: ISO-8601 publish timestamp, or null when unknown

publishedByName.description: Name of the person who published it, when known

removedReason.description: Why its content was removed: pruned to stay within storage, or deleted; a removed version can't be read or restored

restoredFromVersionNumber.description: Version this one restored, for a restore

title.description: Chart title recorded with the version

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for older versions, or null on the last page

title: List chart versions
